rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pronoun for a female person or animal, as well as for other genders.

example.english: I’m going to the movies with her tomorrow; she says the film is good.
example.traditional: 我聽日同佢去睇戲，佢話套戲好睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 tung4 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 hei3 keoi5 waa6 tou3 hei3 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this specifically in formal or Standard Written Chinese contexts when you want to mark the referent as female.

example.english: I heard she is the new colleague at our company.
example.traditional: 她係我哋公司嘅新同事。
example.jyutping: taa1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 san1 tung4 si6
